text:
Debrief DB-021
1) The exercise was conducted in a controlled test range with telemetry logging enabled throughout the session.
2) The actor modified the drone fleet's expected waypoint data to trigger off-route deviation behavior.
3) All sensor feeds and command channels were mirrored to the central audit server for the duration of the run.
4) The actor broadcast a signal that caused the delivery units to suspend their current pathing logic.
5) Two observation teams positioned at perimeter points documented the sequence of events on independent channels.
6) The actor directed the affected units toward a pre-selected landing site within the test boundary.
7) The range's signal monitoring station recorded anomalous traffic patterns matching the actor's transmission profile.
8) The actor retrieved the simulated packages from the landed units after they completed the deviation maneuver.
9) The logging system tagged the session with a spoofing signature indicator for post-analysis review.
10) The actor ceased transmissions and exited the test area following package retrieval.
